projects.name: Terminal-Based Coding Agent
projects.description: Autonomous terminal coding assistant with a multi-turn ReAct loop for iterative perception, tool chaining, and self-correction across up to 25 turns

projects.name: Purplexity
projects.description: AI search engine combining Tavily Web Search and Google Gemini via the Vercel AI SDK, generating real-time streaming answers with dynamic web citations

projects.name: GitArchHub
projects.description: Git-style version control and collaboration platform for architects — 3D visual diffing, role-based branching, and CAD/BIM file support built for design files Git wasn't designed to handle

projects.name: PaperCast
projects.description: Converts research papers into interactive two-host AI podcasts, using a Level-3 citation crawler over the OpenAlex API and an LLM-driven dialogue synthesizer, with pause/resume voice interaction grounded in the citation graph
